newsitem.title: USA: Brite Voice sees Q2 EPS Loss $0.02-$0.04.
newsitem.headline: Brite Voice sees Q2 EPS Loss $0.02-$0.04.

text.p: Brite Voice Systems Inc said Friday it expects to report second quarter revenues of between $28.5 million and $29.5 million and a quarterly loss of between $0.02 and $0.04 a share.

The earnings projection excludes the effect of a previously announced headquarters relocation and restructuring. Charges in the current quarter related to the relocation and restructuring are expected to be about $7 million pretax.

According to First Call, the mean earnings estimate for the second quarter has been a profit of $0.07 a share, compared with a year-ago profit of $0.24. The range of analyst estimates for the quarter has been a profit of $0.05 to a profit of $0.09.
Brite said that the earnings shortfall is mainly from continued weakness in telecommunications consulting revenues and to lower than expected equipment sales.
Brite said it expects to announce final quarterly results during the week of July 25.
"We are disappointed in this quarter's results," David Gergacz, president, said in a statement. "In addition to slower than anticipated revenue growth, our costs remain higher than we would like."
Gergacz said the company is addressing these problems, adding it seems "many encouraging signs" for the third quarter.

"Our sales activity remains at very high levels, and we have recently won several major new accounts at network operators worldwide," he added. "Our marketplace is changing very rapidly, providing significant opportunity for growth."
Brite provides telecommunications systems and services.
